en.unitButton_straightShooter: Shoots left or right. Input coordinates again to change direction.
en.unitButton_verticalShooter: Shoots a laser up and down.
en.unitButton_trackingBeam: Fires a laser at the nearest enemy, and deals high damage.
en.unitButton_bomb: Destroys <color=#E1341E>all units</color> in its range. Input coordinates again to detonate.
en.dialogue_intro: Commander, this is Mother Base. Sorry to wake you up early, but we are under attack! Set up our defenses!
en.system_intro1: <color=#0CCF5A>In this game, you'll create units to defend your base. Start by selecting this unit with the left mouse button.</color>
en.system_intro2: <color=#0CCF5A>Next, put the unit on a space. To do that, we will create an <color=#06DDEF>ordered pair</color>. First, select the value on the X axis with the left mouse button or by pressing the number on the keyboard.</color>
en.system_intro3: <color=#0CCF5A>Now select the value on the Y axis the same way.</color>
en.buildQueueFull: Can only build 3 units at a time!
en.dialogue_build_second_unit: Good job, commander. Build one more unit to back up the first one!
en.dialogue_activate_ability: Commander, order the new unit to fire in the other direction.
en.system_activate_ability: <color=#0CCF5A>To activate a unit's special ability, re-enter the coordinates where the unit is located.</color>
en.system_ordered_pair_reinforcement: <color=#0CCF5A>Nice work. Remember, an ordered pair always starts with a value on the X axis, and then a value on the Y axis.</color>
en.dialogue_enemy_incoming: Commander, the enemy is about to attack! Get ready!
en.dialogue_end_of_tutorial: All enemies defeated. Good job commander, but we can't rest yet. We've detected more enemies coming our way!
en.dialogue_intro_level1: Commander, the enemy is here. We have figured out when they are going to attack. Use this time to prepare our defenses!
en.system_intro_level1_a: <color=#0CCF5A>Every enemy portal has a visible timer to let you know when their attack starts. Build some units while the enemy is getting ready to attack.</color>
en.system_intro_level1_b: <color=#0CCF5A>Mother Base has provided some <color=#06DDEF>scrap parts</color> for you to build your units. If you need more scrap, <color=#06DDEF>destroy enemies with your units.</color> Good luck!</color>
en.dialogue_crystal_intro: Commander, a <color=#06DDEF>crystal</color> has appeared at the <color=#06DDEF>origin</color>. If you <color=#06DDEF>enter its coordinates</color>, we can use it to build more units.
en.dialogue_intro_level2: This is Mother Base. We've created a new unit for you. Deploy it when you're ready.
en.dialogue_intro_level3: Commander, we've detected a new type of enemy. <color=#06DDEF>This enemy will attack your units</color>. Try to protect them as best as you can. Good luck!
